description:
UnitySVC runs the official Dashy image in a separate container for each enrollment, with its own HTTPS address. Dashy is a self-hosted start page: you describe sections, links, icons, themes and widgets (weather, RSS feeds, status checks and more) in one YAML file, and Dashy shows them as a dashboard. You can edit the configuration in the page with its visual editor. The configuration is kept in the `dashy` folder of your home, so it survives stopping the instance and even removing it and enrolling again.

Enroll in the base channel and keep or replace the generated password. Open `https://<instance>/` and your browser asks for the login name and password; Dashy checks them on the server before it reads or saves your configuration or runs a status check. You can run one Dashy instance at a time. See How to use this service for full setup and limitations.

You pay the selected channel's platform compute cost while the instance runs, including idle time, and the platform keeps the configuration in your home while it is stopped. Labs adds no markup and receives no seller payout. See the upstream Dashy documentation and issue tracker for software-specific help.

features: Sections, links, icons and themes defined in one YAML file
Visual configuration editor in the page, with automatic backups of earlier versions
Widgets such as weather, RSS feeds and system information
Status checks for the services you link to
Your configuration is kept in your home, across stops, restarts and re-enrollment
